query:
UPDATE time_entries
           SET invoice_id = $1,
               state = 'invoiced',
               rounded_minutes = billed.minutes
           FROM unnest($2::uuid[], $3::int4[]) AS billed(id, minutes)
           WHERE time_entries.id = billed.id
             AND invoice_id IS NULL
             AND NOT is_running
             AND state IN ('open', 'approved')
